fusions.name: Rattle of Links
fusions.desc: Whips a length of links at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Fist over Fist
fusions.desc: Hooks a target up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Linked Arms
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Passed Down the Line
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt of lightning strikes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
